parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The description of the custom attribute. The value is fuzzy matched.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the custom attribute. The value is matched by plain text containment.

parameters.name: EntityTypes
parameters.description: The entity types to which the custom attribute applies. Separate multiple entity types with commas, such as `*-table,*-column`. Specific entity types (such as hms-table and emr-table) and wildcard types `*-table` and `*-column` are supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: Asc and Desc.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The sort field. Valid values: CreateTime and ModifyTime.
